newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar closes at the top of its range.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar closes at the top of its range.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed near the top of its range on Tuesday having taken a sharp knock down in morning trading.
It ended at 5.00 p.m. at US$0.6895/0S from its 0.6853/60 level mid-morning. It had opened at 0.6883/90. The Trade-Weighted Index ended at 68.22 from a 67.76 low.
Dealers said the market had got itself short after a big U.S. seller had hoovered up all offering interest in the morning.
"The market feels as though it needs quite a lot of kiwi. It could go higher," one said.
